domain_hint: FEA of an aluminum antenna support arm for launch and on-orbit loads
ambiguity_notes:
- Mesh/solution quality: claims 0.5 mm refinement and 1.8% stabilization, but final runs used a coarser mesh and turned off curvature control for some cases.
- Test-analysis agreement: memo cites “within 5%” using AlSi10Mg surrogate tests, yet the model/material is 7075-T7351 and linear-elastic; elsewhere it mentions elastoplastic checks that aren’t in the input deck.
- Joint/contact modeling: text states minimal impact from joint modeling, while attached sensitivity shows 11–14% stress increase with contact and pretension.
- Tool/solver consistency: says cross-solver difference <3%, but high-gradient regions show up to 12% and precision settings differ.
- Boundary conditions/usage context: assumes fully fixed deck; a flexible representation shifts deflection/modes, contradicting the summary tables.
- Geometry/as-built: margins based on nominal 8 mm fillet, while metrology shows ~6.4 mm causing ~14% stress increase not reflected in the headline factors.
